title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Define a process to document and track each cybersecurity project, such as a formal Project Management Office (PMO).

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Maintain a cybersecurity project tracking system, such as a PMO tool, to track each cybersecurity project.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity project tracking system is used to document each active cybersecurity project.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity project tracking system prioritizes each active cybersecurity project.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity project tracking system tracks the capital implementation costs for each active cybersecurity project.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity project tracking system is used to track the personnel implementation costs for each active cybersecurity project.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity project tracking system is used to track the status of each active cybersecurity project.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Define a process to document and track each approved cybersecurity exception when it causes information systems or software applications to be out of compliance with approved cybersecurity safeguards.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Define a process to document which business stakeholders are authorized to approve cybersecurity exceptions in the cybersecurity exception process.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Maintain a system, such as a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system or risk register, to track all approved and documented cybersecurity exceptions to approved cybersecurity safeguards.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Define a process to document and track each issue or defect when it causes information systems or software applications to be out of compliance with approved cybersecurity safeguards.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Assign appropriate resources to address each cybersecurity project and issue in a timely manner.

title: Safeguard Implementation Management Policy
definition: Regularly review each cybersecurity project, cybersecurity exception, and cybersecurity issue related to approved cybersecurity safeguards, and report the status of each to the organization's leadership team.
